Vintage book cover titled 'ANACREONTICS' by Carl Benson, featuring classical figures and cherubs.

Title page text reading "ANAGREONTICS BY CARL BENSON" in gold lettering on a brown background.

Decorative engraving of three cherubs holding a scroll with the text 'GRANDS VINS de MEDOC' surrounded by grapevines.
